title: storyStoreV7: TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'defaultExport.id'
body:
**Describe the bug**
When trying to use storystorev7 in 6.4.0-beta.14 with Angular, stories do not load and I get the following error 
```
[Warning] TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'defaultExport.id') (vendors-node_modules_storybook_addon-actions_dist_esm_preset_addArgs_js-node_modules_storyboo-b506eb.iframe.bundle.js, line 196413)
processCSFFile — processCSFFile.js:48
memoizerific — memoizerific.js:170
tryCatch — runtime.js:63
invoke — runtime.js:294
asyncGeneratorStep — StoryStore.js:13
_next — StoryStore.js:15
(anonymous function) — zone.js:160
(anonymous function) — zone.js:1318
(anonymous function) — zone.js:205
drainMicroTaskQueue — zone.js:620
promiseReactionJob
```

**To Reproduce**
Just make a new storybook project using Angular 12 and turn on StoryStoreV7
[minimal reproduction branch](https://github.com/literalpie/sb-ng-performance/tree/storystorev7-angular)

**System**
```
  System:
    OS: macOS 11.6
    CPU: (12) x64 Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-1650 v2 @ 3.50GHz
  Binaries:
    Node: 16.11.1 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.11.1/bin/node
    Yarn: 3.0.1 - /usr/local/bin/yarn
    npm: 8.0.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.11.1/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 94.0.4606.81
    Firefox: 93.0
    Safari: 15.0
  npmPackages:
    @storybook/addon-actions: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/addon-docs: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/addon-essentials: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/addon-links: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/angular: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/builder-webpack5: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/manager-webpack5: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
    @storybook/preview-web: ^6.4.0-beta.14 => 6.4.0-beta.14 
```
**Additional context**
* In my quick debugging, it seems like processCSFFile expects an object, but gets a promise of an object. 
* working around the issue (with `defaultExport?.id` and `defaultExport?.argTypes`) results in different errors:
```
[Warning] TypeError: null is not an object (evaluating '_storyObject.story') (vendors-node_modules_angular-devkit_build-angular_node_modules_css-loader_dist_runtime_api_js-3cfd8c.iframe.bundle.js, line 119185)
normalizeStory — normalizeStory.js:51
(anonymous function) — processCSFFile.js:79
forEach
processCSFFile — processCSFFile.js:77
memoizerific — memoizerific.js:170
tryCatch — runtime.js:63
invoke — runtime.js:294
asyncGeneratorStep — StoryStore.js:13
_next — StoryStore.js:15
(anonymous function) — zone.js:160
(anonymous function) — zone.js:1318
(anonymous function) — zone.js:205
drainMicroTaskQueue — zone.js:620

```
